body:
_Migrated from issue #883, filed 2026-07-13._

**Requested by** @iroQuai in #699 (part of the highlights follow-ups).

## What
Add a second highlight-import path that accepts a plain-text **`My Clippings.txt`** file (the Kindle format). Each clipping carries the book title/author, a highlight/note/bookmark type, a page or location, an added date, and the text. This is the practical bridge for KOReader and xteink micro-readers too: recent xteink firmwares (Crosspoint, CrossInk) save on-device highlights in the same Kindle-style `My Clippings.txt`.

## Where
- Current import is Kobo `.sqlite`-only: `POST /annotations/import` (`cps/annotations.py:75`) gates on `looks_like_sqlite` and parses via `parse_kobo_bookmarks` (`cps/services/kobo_import.py`).
- Add a sibling parser `cps/services/clippings_import.py` (pure, unit-testable) that turns a `My Clippings.txt` byte stream into normalized annotation rows, and branch the import route on file type (sqlite → Kobo path, text → clippings path).
- Persist into the same `ub.Annotation` store the Kobo path writes to (loader: `_load_user_annotations`, `cps/annotations.py:269`), so the existing per-book view + MD/CSV/JSON export + count badge all work unchanged.

## Hard parts to get right
- **Book matching** by title/author against the Calibre library — clippings have no book id. Match conservatively; surface unmatched clippings rather than silently dropping them.
- **Format variance / i18n** — `My Clippings.txt` separators and the "Your Highlight on ..." header are localized across Kindle firmwares. Parse defensively; reject nothing that's clearly a clipping.
- **Dedup on re-import** — key on (book, location/page, text) so re-uploading the same file doesn't duplicate rows.
- **Notes + bookmarks**, not just highlights — the format mixes all three; map them to the annotation types we already store.

## OSS / rules
No new dependency (stdlib text parsing). No external service. Validate/allowlist the parsed fields before they reach the DB.

Design + parser spec + verify matrix: `notes/699-koreader-highlights-DESIGN.md`.

Part of #699.
title: Import highlights from a Kindle/KOReader `My Clippings.txt` file
